requirement: The visual check is told where the two pictures' pixels changed and sees each small changed place enlarged, so a recoloured menu link is not read as unchanged; a not_shown whose target is outside the window is no claim

oracle.ref: PR #1750 (fix); fix evidence: cowork.tracy.site 25/10/2026, saigon-iron-boxing: five turns asked a top-menu link (ABOUT, PLANS, CLASSES) in another colour; site_turn.visual = not_shown for all five, the stored picture after showed the new colour each time and the comparison said 'still white'. Replay of 18 dev picture pairs x 3 against deepseek-flash: 39/54 right before, 52/54 after.
oracle.invariant: S1: identical pictures give share 0 and no place; the recoloured link gives exactly one place covering it, cut out of both pictures at 4x with white in the middle before and blue after; the four spots stay four places in reading order and only three are cut out; the banner is named but only the link is cut out; a mostly changed window has no cut; mismatched or unreadable pictures give null. S2: not_shown with inWindow false reads cannot_tell, with inWindow true or absent stays not_shown, shown stays shown; the judge message carries the MEASURED line right after the main pair and a BEFORE/AFTER pair per cut place, before other pages; the check stores four pictures, sends four images and reports measured {places: 1, zoomed: 1}; at another scroll nothing is measured and the message has two images; every test of both files passes.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
